scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I submitted a housing loan application a little while ago, and I was hoping to get an update on its status.
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, LOAN-01860, has been originated.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Can you tell me if my application was approved and what the interest rate is?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan was originated. The interest rate for your loan is 6.99%.

dialogue.user: Okay, 6.99%. And what are the total costs associated with this loan? Also, could you confirm the loan term? I believe it was for 360 months.
dialogue.agent: The total loan costs associated with your loan are $11,950.69. The loan term is indeed 360 months.

dialogue.user: Thank you for confirming. I have one more question: has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan was sold to Fannie Mae.

dialogue.user:
Okay, thank you for all the information.

<Satisfied> I'm satisfied with the interaction. You were able to provide clear answers to all my questions about the loan's status, interest rate, total costs, term, and whether it was sold.
